audience: IT admins who manage company phones and tablets with Scalefusion

useCases.title: Check devices and their battery levels
useCases.text: List managed devices with their ids and status. Read the battery level and charging state of one device.

useCases.title: Find a device by IMEI or serial number
useCases.text: Search devices by IMEI or serial number, then open one to read its group, profile and OS.

useCases.title: Check where a device was last seen
useCases.text: Read the latest 10 recorded locations of one managed device. Use it only for devices you are allowed to track.

useCases.title: Lock or unlock a set of devices
useCases.text: Lock devices now, or unlock them again. A lock applies device policies at once to real devices in the field.

useCases.title: Move a device to another group
useCases.text: List the device groups, then move one device to another group. The profile policies of that group then apply.
